name: Unity Movement
goalName: Implement input, movement, look and camera in first person and third person
goal: These are basic concepts required in (almost) every game. An important note is to keep SOLID in mind, as this provides structure for a clear overview. A good structure is not only important for yourself, but also when you share your work.

result: The result is achieved using the code below, in which I did much thinkering.<<image 0.png>><<image 1.png>>The first person movement was fairly easy to implement. For third person however, I tried many times to figure it out and searched online for solutions. At the end of the day, I read the spoiler script and saw the solution was way easier than my tries. Although I had to look up the solution, I got a better understanding of rotation and quaternions. My result can be seen in the following video:<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/sM10hW5GFak>>
validation: I sent the first person movement to an expert, who was surprised by the way I implemented it (in a good way). I did many tests, to see if gravity behaved, and the rotation worked as expected.
contribution: Now that I got basic movement setup and structured, it is time to work on other mechanics.
